## 類別 / Type

## 內容 / Details
請描述遇到的情況、預期結果及重現步驟。一般意見可直接留言。
Describe what happened, what you expected and how to reproduce it, or share your feedback.

請勿附上 API key、密碼、個人資料或未遮蔽的私人存檔。內容會公開顯示在 GitHub。毋須 GitHub 帳號的話，可直接到官網留言牆留言。
Do not include API keys, passwords, personal data or unredacted saves. Issues are public on GitHub; the website memo wall accepts messages without a GitHub account.
Do not include API keys, passwords, personal information or unredacted private saves. Posts are public on GitHub and the website.
